# Tenable

> Tenable provides cybersecurity exposure management solutions including Nessus vulnerability scanner, Security Center, and compliance tools for critical infrastructure protection.

Tenable is a leading cybersecurity company specializing in vulnerability management, network security, and regulatory compliance. Their flagship products include Nessus (vulnerability scanner), Security Center, and Passive Vulnerability Scanner (PVS), serving organizations across government, healthcare, and critical infrastructure sectors.

## Key Topics

- Nessus vulnerability scanner
- Security Center platform
- Passive Vulnerability Scanner (PVS)
- Vulnerability management
- Network security monitoring
- PCI DSS compliance
- Critical infrastructure cybersecurity
- Web application security
- Nessus plugins
- CVSS risk scoring
- Patch management
- Configuration auditing
- CISA regulations
- Authenticated scanning
- Threat detection

- [Oil and Gas Pipeline Cybersecurity](https://www.tenable.com/cybersecurity-regulations/oil-and-pipeline): TSA oil & gas pipeline cybersecurity compliance solutions
